description:
Top-level comments on a TikTok video by URL or ID: text, likes, reply count, time, pinned and creator-liked flags and the commenter, plus the video's total comment count. Up to 100 comments.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `id`.
Returns: video_id (string), comment_count (integer, nullable), comments (array<object>), comments_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return. Example: 20

name: tiktok_comments
title: TikTok video comments
